model.name: T21.2: Lobby renders real name on first connect
model.description: RoomBrowser must show the actual profile name immediately on connect, never a blank/random fallback that only corrects on a second reload. Fix: re-render the name+avatar block on the PROFILE event (one-shot guarded), not just patch the input value; first paint uses cached profile name or a neutral skeleton. Verified headless against the running app.
